Transport Documents

Biên Nhận Hàng Hóa

An official acknowledgment issued by a carrier or warehouse operator confirming physical receipt of specified cargo for storage or onward transport.

Quick answer: An official acknowledgment issued by a carrier or warehouse operator confirming physical receipt of specified cargo for storage or onward transport.

An official acknowledgment issued by a carrier or warehouse operator confirming physical receipt of specified cargo for storage or onward transport.

Why it matters

Biên Nhận Hàng Hóa matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

What is Biên Nhận Hàng Hóa?

In this glossary, Biên Nhận Hàng Hóa refers to: An official acknowledgment issued by a carrier or warehouse operator confirming physical receipt of specified cargo for storage or onward transport.

How is Biên Nhận Hàng Hóa used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Kho phát hành biên nhận hàng hóa để xác nhận đã nhận và chịu trách nhiệm về hàng hóa được lưu trữ."

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

An official acknowledgment issued by a carrier or warehouse operator confirming physical receipt of specified cargo for storage or onward transport.

The warehouse issued a cargo receipt to confirm acceptance and responsibility for the stored goods.
